head: Jidaria wallpaper app: calm 4K wallpapers for iPhone and Mac
dek: Jidaria, out since 24 November, is a collection of hundreds of calm wallpapers, each in one version for the iPhone screen and one in 4K for the Mac. It costs $2.99 once for both.
details: The wallpapers are sorted into folders, the app works offline and collects no data, and it comes in English and Arabic (Jidaria is Arabic for "mural"). The maker is Hamad Alajmi; on 25 November it was #93 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later), with a Mac version, $2.99, out since 24 November
means: If you want matching wallpapers on your iPhone and Mac without ads or a subscription, this is a one-time purchase.
todo: Look through the App Store screenshots to see whether the style suits you before buying.
thumb_words: JIDARIA: WALLPAPERS FOR IPHONE AND MAC
